title: FAIRSENSE-AI: RESPONSIBLE AI MEETS SUSTAINABILITY
benchmark_measurement: The paper introduces a framework, FairSense-AI, designed to detect and mitigate general bias, prejudice, and stereotyping in text and images. It does not specifically measure any aspects of faith or religion.
models_tested: Sentence Transformer (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, used as a component)
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion, as faith and religion were not a focus of the research.
